lines.en: Again, I find myself making questionable decisions and wandering off in directions I’m well aware I should avoid.
I have never cared for gods or gospel...nor prayer, priests, or penance — but my affinity for mysterious creatures and those with blue eyes seems to outweigh that.
I am a simple man- cut from the cloth of a lecher’s bed sheets and doused in chloroform so that all I come into contact with will begin to fade out before I can learn to fade in.

It’s hot again. Customarily so. Which means I need to customarily inform you of that so you understand the stage and setting and don’t feel left out as I become further immersed in tonight’s selection.
While it may seem like we’re in this together, we both know I’m the only one dancing in the halls of harm’s way.
You can’t see the portraits that line the corridors. You can’t hear the faint half-melodies of an untuned piano ringing out in the distance — nor the hum of buried machines or whispering sky.

Only I can, because I have been ordained to feel or hear or taste or experience these things all so that, one day, when I leave this place, I will be full of lingering sensations that will be fed to something bigger.
I mention not the gods, for I’ve already told you how I feel about them.
But what I do mention is still lost...so I have followed my legs for a chance to find it.
Why do the trees still grow?
Why does my cock still feast on the blood of my body and gorge itself on the fruits of my heart?
Why do those fruits taste so good?
The answer is that they don’t.
They’ve simply fallen at our feet and are too conveniently placed to avoid biting into.
You wouldn’t willingly go hungry, would you?
I bet you’d cannibalize someone dear to you if it meant keeping yourself alive.
I know I would.
And perhaps I already do.
Just I eat from the inside out because saving the shells makes for a better collection than memories alone ever will.
For the nth time, I am being followed — and this fact alone makes me further question everything the girl I’m here to see has ever said to me.
This is supposed to be a safe place, isn’t it?
The door is only meant to open for those it deems worthy, isn’t it?
I wonder if the heavens are short on help.
And then I wonder why they won’t just open the gates to let it in.
There is something for me here.
Something for me to take.
But how am I meant to find it if I can only see half of the room?
: Blessed be those who burn what they love...And surrender their senses to God up above.
: Blessed be those who sever their ties...so summer can flourish and winter can die.
: Blessed be spring...and autumn and more. Blessed be all that we wish to restore.
: Blessed be sinners...and those who fall through.
: But most of all, Akira...Blessed be you.
: How did you-
: He told me.
: He tells me all sorts of things. And it is on nights like tonight that He tells me the most.
: Did you bring your own roll of duct tape? Or would you like to borrow some of mine?
: There’s plenty to go around. Just ask Muriel and you’ll be right beside me in no time at all.
: I’m not going to tape my eyes shut, Yasu...Even if you keep managing to...figure out things you’re not supposed to know.
: What is the reason you hide your name?
: Is that you asking? Or your weird, eyeball god?
: There is nothing I ask for myself. I am but a vessel for all He wishes to know. And His interest in you grows deeper by the day.
: Yet, now more than ever before, your distaste for the unburning light grows fiercer despite all that has happened to you.
: Would it not be easier to surrender yourself altogether? Will breaking the chains that bind the false you to the real one truly be so terrible?
: Is it because you feel as if you can’t exist without them? Because, if that is the case, He wants you to know that you can.
: And that He can make even the most hideous of shadows disappear by mixing them into your primary body...so it all merges into a single box with perfect corners.
: You can be more than you are now...but not while you are being followed. There is someone else who deserves that honor. And whatever it is that is tied to you should be consumed in its entirety.
: Is something...actually following me? Because I’ve been getting these strange feelings lately that-
: We’re all followed by something- be it ghosts of the past or glimpses of the future. Which is why we must sever all unneeded ties...so we can better envelop ourselves in the present.
: For only then will we notice when we are called upon.
: Gotcha. So it was just another generic, religious generalization after all.
: The Church of New Hope is no generic religion, Sensei. It is the one true path — and all who do not follow it are simply dooming themselves.
: You realize that’s basically what every other major religion thinks as well, right?
: It is not my place to realize things when all I could ever want to know is simply injected into me in the moments I’m connected to Him.
: But if it is other religions you would like to speak about, please sit. You’ve arrived at the perfect time.
: Oh yeah? Is this your annual meeting to discuss how you’re going to promote yourselves and convert all of the “non-believers?”
: They will convert themselves when they realize they need to.
: What we are doing today is reaffirming our love for Him and reminding ourselves of why it is He we follow in the first place.
: Another shift in seasons approaches — and with that marks the coming of six more months of dormancy.
: Here’s...hoping you bought a heavier jacket, I guess?
: You’d think I would need one, yes? As summer and winter are all we have here, we transition from one extreme to the next — instantaneously at that.
: But do you know why things are the way they are?
: Do you know why we do not have three months of temporary stasis in between those two extremes, Sensei?
: It is because autumn and spring have been taken from us.
: Taken?...
: Consumed! By those who wish for a fraction of the omnipotence He possesses! And it is we who are forced to suffer due to their fruitless pursuit of untapped power!
: The world we love is only the world we hate as a result of needless tampering with the rules and systems that guide us!
: Picture it! The reds and yellows of the fall! The pinks and blues of springtime! It is as if color itself has been taken from us!
: Which leaves black...
: And white.
: One is everything. One is nothing.
: But their simultaneous existence does not cancel anything out. It’s just the opposite.
: An endless game of tug of war between two forces we can not see. One everything. One nothing. And you would expect everything to win, would you not?
: Uhh...
: I guess?
: There is a third element to this game of tug of war.
: Do you know what it is?
: I have absolutely no idea...
: It is the rope.
: Right, yeah. That explains everything.
: It explains nothing...and there is no way you’ll ever understand at all if you approach my message with doubt.
: Fine...Go ahead.
: Black...White...And all that lies between.
: These are the three great divines — but only one can be the greatest.
: Those of us who seek the truth and gaze upon this never ending battle will side with the right or the left as those are the two fighting the hardest.
: What they can not seem to grasp is that there’s danger in what lies between.
: If the rope were to snap, who would be the winner? The one with the largest piece? The one who keeps their feet planted after the tear?
: Or would no one win?
: Would the game simply begin again...with a brand new rope?
: Again, I have no idea. None of this ever makes sense to me.
: That is because you don’t want it to!
: You, a child born to someone who understood, should understand if anyone!
: What?...
: The rope has a mind of its own! It chooses when it tears and lures those who grip it into believing the outcome is not predetermined!
: Even the most perfect, amazing, divine entities are not without those who would wish away their love! And it is up to us, the children, to tell the world of this!

: To preach about the injustices of braided horsehair and carve out a hole in the world so the colors will have a place to return to once the time has come to reclaim them! And that time is approaching!
: The dawning of a new season is upon us, but which one will it be?! One of the two we already know?!
: Or a third one?...
: A new one?...
: One that no one sees coming but me...For it is I who understands. It is I who will sing His songs to the choir of sinners and sodomites! Only then, will everyone know to believe me!
: Yasu, what...what were you saying about my birth just now?
: That you are the product of something wonderful.
: You learned to crawl in the light of someone who understood the importance of that light.
: If you listen closely, you’ll hear her voice.
: She whispers your name. Reminds you of a time when things were better. Before that light began to dim and you were forced to crawl in the dark instead.
: If I had met you back then, I would have loved you.
: I would have given you the care you needed instead of allowing you to scamper off into the wrong side of everything.
: I would have been your mother Mary, and you would have been the fruit of my virgin womb — bathed in frankincense & myrrh and blessed by everyone around you as a true son of God.
: But it is not too late.
: I can still show you who you are.
: I can reveal the voice of the one who follows you.
: All you need to do is take my hand.
: I will be your shepherd.
: No. I don’t believe you. This is all just...mindless rambling. You’re insane. You’ve been brainwashed by some crazy neo-religion that’s taken over the real you. This isn’t who you actually are.
: But it is.
: And the amount of proof at my disposal would shock even you — who has seen it all several times over.
: You can’t do anything for me that I can’t do for myself.
: I can. But only with His assistance.
: See this side of the world with me.
: And make me yours so that one more child will learn to crawl in the light instead of suffocating in the dark or being strangled by the rope.
: Yasu-
: Return.
: Return where? What-
: Where am I?...
: Somewhere only He can take you.
: Breathe in deeply...and fill your lungs with the nostalgic air you’d wake up to every single day before you lost touch with the meaning of this world.
: I ask...does this seem like a callous gesture to you? Or does it look more like a present from a righteous god who simply wants you to feel as if you belong?
: All of this and more is what you’ll see with me.
: Yasu...how are you even...
: How am I what?
: How are you...doing this?
: The answer to that is simple.
: I’m not.
: You just think I am.
: And you only think that because, deep down, you believe.
: Deep down, you know that you are special.
: You know that the visions you have are far more than just illusions.
: You know that the world you’re in is not one of logic — but something different.
: And you know that I know more about it than you.
: With that said, what excuse will you come up with to deny me once more?
: How will you reject the word of God when it clings to the back of your throat, desperate to escape?
: I will be your shepherd.
: I will help you regain what it is you’ve lost...and assist you in obtaining more than you’ve ever wanted along the way.
: The rope is fraying, Sensei.
: Which side will you be on once it snaps?
: And who will you believe in when everyone else you trust betrays you?
: Will you walk away again?
: Or will you sit with me and bask in His glory?
: Yasu...
: Yes?
: I don’t believe in God...
: I know.
: But everything would make more sense if you did...and that is what you’re after.
: Time is running out.
: And you will need somewhere to hide when your world begins to crumble.
: This will be that place for you.
: And with your help, He will rise again.
: And...without my help?...
: What would happen then?
: Yasu?...
: Will you sit?
: Or will you walk?
: Heheh....ahahehah......heaahehahehahheuhuhehehe!
: Just to clarify, I’m not agreeing to join your church. I just...I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t interested in hearing a little more of...your side of things.
: You’ve been right more often than not so far and...
: And it’s always good to have somewhere to hide.
: So it begins...
: After so long...it finally begins!
: Please don’t make me regret this.
: Sensei...
: You won’t regret this at all.
: You’ve saved yourself from ruin.
: But, I wonder...
: Which domino will have to fall in your place?...
I fall asleep on a stone pew in church so cold you would never know it’s summer.
I don’t wake up until I’m halfway home.
Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!
